Glad you got it working. I saved a note to the project's memory store: newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access`, or the invoice PDF tests fail. That should save the next person from debugging it again.

When this conversation started, git showed no uncommitted changes in the repo. If your fix only exists on your machine (in your environment or a local config), it would help to commit it or document it, so CI and other developers don't hit the same failure.
